issues.problem: Title renders visibly heavier/bolder than reference (reference looks ~500-600 weight, build ~700) and ends 1px earlier (x=289 vs 290).

issues.problem: Card is ~2px shorter and 1px narrower than reference (ref ~246x68 ending x=354,y=527; build ends x=353,y=525); subtitle baseline sits 1px higher (y=505 vs 506).

issues.problem: Reference has a clear ~2px dark (#161d18-ish) border plus a hard dark bottom edge/shadow; build border is thinner and fainter, and the card is ~1-2px shorter (ref y 94-155, build 94-154).
issues.fix: Use border: 2px solid the dark ink color on the active card, add the bottom offset shadow (e.g. box-shadow: 0 2px 0 ink), keep outer height 62px.

issues.region: right panel, cards 2-3 and Add place / Share row
issues.problem: Everything below card 1 sits 1px higher than reference (card text y 184/254 vs 185/255; button row y 325 vs 326), a knock-on from the short active card.

issues.region: right panel, active card drag handle
issues.problem: Handle dots on the active card are dark grey and heavier in build; reference shows smaller, lighter olive-green dots (lower contrast against the lime fill) than on the inactive cards.
issues.fix: On the active card set the handle color to a muted olive (approx rgba(22,29,24,0.45)) and match the 2x3 dot size from Figma.

issues.problem: Arrows are smaller and shifted ~2px left (ref x=1386/1409, build 1384/1408) and '2019' label is 1px right (1330 vs 1329).
issues.fix: Increase arrow glyph size ~1-2px to match and nudge the arrow group 2px right; check the gap between the year label and arrows.

issues.problem: Bars drift ~1px horizontally through the middle of the row (2003-2018) and the faded future bars (2020-2025) differ slightly in opacity/edge position.

issues.fix: Set fixed integer bar widths/gaps from Figma instead of fractional sizing; reduce label left offset by 1px.

issues.problem: Caption pill is 1px narrower (right edge 379 vs 380); Pacific pin sits 1px up-left (93,447 vs 94,448).
issues.fix: Add 1px horizontal padding to the caption pill; shift the pin by +1px,+1px.
